_note: All three are rejected in the access phase and are indistinguishable from each other and from a missing token. That is correct security behaviour and genuinely hard for an integrator to self-diagnose — which is why request-id is on the API and why the README tells you to ask for X-Request-Id first.

_why_each_matters.forged-signature: proves the RS256 signature is verified against Okta's JWKS, not merely parsed
_why_each_matters.alg-none: proves an unsigned token is refused — accept_unsupported_alg defaults to TRUE, so this is not free
_why_each_matters.wrong-issuer: proves the token is specific to THIS API, not just valid somewhere
